ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** on iOS and Android, with location never asked, open Explore and decline the prompt; switch tabs and come back twice; then turn location off for Chronicles in Settings (iOS "Never", Android "Don't allow"), come back to the app on Explore, dismiss the notice, switch tabs and come back; force-quit and reopen; then turn location back on in Settings and come back to the app. **Expect:** the system prompt is raised once that launch, never again by a front; refused with areas listed, the quiet notice "Location is turned off for Chronicles. Turn it on in Settings to find your position." with Open Settings, said by VoiceOver and TalkBack, at each front until dismissed, then not until the app is reopened; refused with nothing listed and the permission reading denied, the empty card says where to turn location on instead, with no notice over it and no Open Settings ("Card only on Explore"; the missing Open Settings asked of the owner, `tend explore T76`'s review); no dot and no walk time on any card; with location back on, a fix is read on the return with no tap. (YH1, YH4, YH5)

**Nov 28, `/tend inbox T76 yes` `--deploy=main`, one build** (opened from `f0a209c1`, rebased on `6729fe64`; the proxy's yes under 0157, 2026-11-28, the owner having said "Proceed autonomously"; an inbox run: lens 0 ran, lenses 1-7 belong to a sweep and were not run).
- T76, "Explore: with no fix and location refused, neither Find me nor the edge Locate shows", built as `tend explore T76`. The screen was right and the checks stale. The cause is G17, but not the list around a town the entry named: Explore asks at its first front (YH1), the e2e's browser refuses every ask, and the front's refusal (`setRefused` in `readHere`'s "off" branch) with the permission reading "denied" is the blocked state of tend explore audits 8 and 9, the card saying where to turn location on with neither Find me nor the edge Locate, which YH4 names. The judgment call: that screen keeps decision 0172 (O6, O20) and G17 both, so no source changed; `qol`'s checks follow it, and the one after the site is allowed now finds the fix read with no tap and the edge Locate as the one way. The new check failed on an export with the front's refusal unwired and passes on the head.
- `qol` ran to its end for the first time since Nov 24: past T76, red at the loop walk's replay (tend map audits 25, 26, 34), 2 runs of 2 that reached it, outside T76's cause: filed as T80.
